from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,re
original=Path('/work/crate'); copy=Path('/work/tmp/review-crate')
changed=[]
for p in original.rglob('*'):
    if p.is_file():
        q=copy/p.relative_to(original)
        if not q.exists() or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest()!=hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).digest():
            changed.append(str(p.relative_to(original)))
print('Original/copy differences in copied files:',changed)
print('Added scratch files:',[str(p.relative_to(copy)) for p in copy.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not (original/p.relative_to(copy)).exists()])
print('Primary source Rust files:',len(list((original/'src').rglob('*.rs'))))
for f in ['extended54-final.log','baseline-skip.log']:
    s=Path('/work/tmp/'+f).read_text()
    totals=[0]*5
    for m in re.finditer(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out',s):
        totals=[a+int(b) for a,b in zip(totals,m.groups())]
    print(f,totals)
